subject.title: Bug: Cron fallback chain broken — models return zero-token success or killed by shared AbortController

question: Is the post-https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100483 evidence sufficient to close this issue, or should it remain open until a fresh current-main reproduction of the timeout/session symptoms is provided?
rationale: Current source proves the empty-result classifier gap was fixed, but it does not prove that the reported outer-timeout or session-persistence symptoms are gone or still broken under the documented cron deadline contract.

options.title: Keep Open For Fresh Evidence
options.body: Leave this issue open and ask for current-main logs with job timeout, model-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and session model fields before closing or queueing another repair.

options.title: Close After No-Repro Proof
options.body: Close only after maintainers or a reporter provide a current-main run showing the remaining symptoms no longer reproduce after the classifier fix.

options.title: Delegate Timeout Work To Linked PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/52365 as the canonical timeout-budget path once it is rebased, proof-cleared, and reviewed.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Fresh Evidence
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and ask for current-main logs with job timeout, model-attempt timestamps, abort reason/time, and session model fields before closing or queueing another repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the landed classifier fix, posted the current maintainer note, and has the strongest recent history on the relevant fallback and cron runtime paths.
